QuestInfo.name: [Construction Site B2] Shumi's Lost Roll of Cash
QuestInfo.1: I ran into #p403# again in #m10003000#. She was really stressed out because she lost her rent money when a #o17# flew over and snatched it from her. Man... Do I have to go back down to the subway again...? Can I just pay her rent for her at this point? Anyway, I need to go back in there, this time to #bConstruction Site B2#k, and find the roll of cash she lost. Aye, better get going...
QuestInfo.2: I got Shumi from #m10003000# the lost roll of cash. Guess she can pay her rent now... and as a reward, she gave me #b30 #t2000003#s#k... She also said I can find other items at #bConstruction Site B2#k... I should go check it out sometime...

0.0: You came! I was waiting for you... because, well... I have a big problem. This time, I didn't just lose a coin; I lost a whole roll of cash. It happened so fast. I looked away for a second, and those #o17# punks took it and ran away. What do you think? Will you help me?

yes.0: I knew you'd say yes! I saw them go into #bConstruction Site B2#k with my roll of money, but I couldn't chase them down there because there was a weird device on the entrance. That money is very important to me... I really need it. I know you can do it, so please find it and bring it back to me!

no.0: You must be busy, huh? But if you ever change your mind, then please help me. I'm being serious here...

1.0: Hey, it's the roll of cash I lost! Phew... I'll be able to pay rent with this... What? How do I know if this is the money that I lost? Look... I wrote my name on it, really small... Can't see it? Are you sure you don't need a pair of glasses?
1.1: Anyway, thank you sooo much. And you helped me out last time too... I keep turning to you for help... Don't worry, I'll reward you handsomely for it... but anyway, you should really look into helping with others' problems as a job... You're pretty good at it.

yes.0: As a sign of appreciation, I bumped up your Fame and EXP a little. And, although too precious to give away, here's a bunch of #t2000003# that I've been collecting for months while traveling... So use them wisely! Next time I find myself in trouble, I'll look to you for help again, so please come, all right?

item.0: Still haven't found the roll of cash that I lost? Without it, I'll be homeless... That's my rent money! You can find it at #bConstruction Site B2#k in the #b#m10003000# Subway#k. Be careful, there's some weird equipment around there. I believe in you.
